final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), bench1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS b1 FROM per_order), s1 AS (SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_fill, p.avg_fill - b.b1 AS margin1 FROM per_order p, bench1 b WHERE p.avg_fill > b.b1), bench2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS b2 FROM s1), s2 AS (SELECT s1.avg_fill, s1.margin1, s1.avg_fill - bench2.b2 AS margin2 FROM s1, bench2 WHERE s1.avg_fill > bench2.b2) SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS avg_fill_final, AVG(margin1) AS avg_margin_over_first, AVG(margin2) AS avg_margin_over_second FROM s2
